LanguageData.CC_Settings_Banishment_Tip: Someone who keeps getting into fights over a month, whom most of the colony can't stand and almost nobody stands by, comes before the council. The first time, the council has a word with them face to face, keeps them to the night hours for a while, or lets it be. Only if the trouble goes on after that does a later question offer to send them away: told face to face, they gather their things and walk out by the edge of the map, through the game's own banishment. Never a child, a prisoner, a slave, a guest, or anyone held under a tie with another people, and never in a colony too small to spare anyone.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_Banishment: A word first for someone who keeps fighting and whom nobody likes; banishment only if it goes on.
